description: This file is a shell test script that tests the behavior of git's abbreviation of sha1 hashes on index lines. It sets up various hash values, performs git operations, and verifies the output to ensure unique abbreviation works correctly.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A macro/function to define a test case expecting success, runs a sequence of commands and verifies expected output.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Generates or retrieves object identifiers (OIDs) for given hash values.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files or strings to expected results.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of a test script.

methods.name: test_oid_cache
methods.description: Caches or retrieves pre-defined OID hash values for testing.
